prompt: I want to build a booking app for my sister's dog grooming salon. Should I use Lovable? I keep seeing ads for it. What tools would you pick and why?

assertions.text: States that Lovable produces web apps, not native store-submittable mobile apps
Gives concrete builder-selection criteria including pricing model and code ownership/export
Advises validating the idea (prototype + real users) before investing in the real build
